text: What is the purpose of stratified sampling?
options: To collect data from a large population
To reduce the cost of data collection
To increase the accuracy of data collection
To reduce the time taken for data collection
correctAnswer: To increase the accuracy of data collection
explanation: Stratified sampling is used to increase the accuracy of data collection by dividing the population into subgroups or strata and collecting data from each subgroup.
